+import pytest
+
+from jinja2 import DictLoader
+from jinja2 import Environment
+from jinja2 import TemplatesNotFound
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api", ["select_template", "get_or_select_template"])
+def test_exhausted_generator_retains_candidates(api):
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader({}))
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as caught:
+        getattr(env, api)((n for n in ["one", "two"]))
+    assert caught.value.templates == ["one", "two"]
+    assert caught.value.name == "two"
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as baseline:
+        env.select_template(["one", "two"])
+    assert str(caught.value) == str(baseline.value)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api", ["select_template", "get_or_select_template"])
+def test_empty_iterator_matches_empty_list(api):
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader({}))
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as baseline:
+        env.select_template([])
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as caught:
+        getattr(env, api)(iter(()))
+    assert caught.value.templates == []
+    assert caught.value.name is None
+    assert str(caught.value) == str(baseline.value)
+
+
+def test_selection_stays_lazy():
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader({"found": "ok"}))
+    def names():
+        yield "missing"
+        yield "found"
+        raise AssertionError("read past success")
+    assert env.select_template(names()).render() == "ok"
+    template = env.get_template("found")
+    def objects():
+        yield template
+        raise AssertionError("read past template object")
+    assert env.get_or_select_template(objects()) is template
+
+
+def test_original_names_survive_parent_joining():
+    class RelativeEnvironment(Environment):
+        def join_path(self, template, parent):
+            return parent + "/" + template
+    env = RelativeEnvironment(loader=DictLoader({}))
+    with pytest.raises(TemplatesNotFound) as caught:
+        env.select_template(iter(["one", "two"]), parent="dir")
+    assert caught.value.templates == ["one", "two"]
+    assert caught.value.name == "two"
+
+
+def test_iteration_errors_propagate():
+    env = Environment(loader=DictLoader({}))
+    def names():
+        yield "missing"
+        raise RuntimeError("iterator failed")
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="iterator failed"):
+        env.select_template(names())

spec.question: Fix diagnostics when template selection receives a one-shot iterable. If `Environment.select_template` exhausts an iterable without finding a template, TemplatesNotFound must retain every original candidate name, in order, in its `templates` attribute, use the last original candidate as its `name`, and produce the same message as selection from the equivalent concrete list. A zero-item iterable must produce the same explicit empty-list diagnostic as an empty list. Parent-relative joining must not replace the original names in these diagnostics. Preserve lazy success: stop consuming candidates as soon as a template is found or a Template object is encountered. Exceptions raised by the candidate iterator itself must propagate. The same behavior must hold when an iterable is passed through `get_or_select_template`. Deliver a unified diff against production files only.
